chunks: 4144 - And he, peace be upon him, said:
“If you send your dog after game, and you catch up with it while you do not have an iron blade with which to slaughter it, then let the dog kill it, and then eat from it.”

key_terms.أَرْسَلْتَ: you dispatched or sent out for hunting
key_terms.حَدِيدَةٌ: an iron blade or instrument for slaughter

ai.seo_question: Can hunted game be eaten if I catch it without having a blade to slaughter it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning hunted game by a trained dog. If the hunter reaches the prey but lacks an iron blade to perform slaughter, the prey may still be eaten if the dog kills it.
